species.real: For all their seaside swagger, herring gulls are on the UK red list of birds of highest conservation concern, because their numbers on the coast have fallen sharply.
species.name: Chipgull

dex.text: Screams like a late-night argument over a bag of chips. Has stolen more lunches than a Monday morning meeting.
dex.fact: Herring gulls have moved from coastal cliffs onto city rooftops, and many now nest on buildings in British towns.

species.real: Herring gulls can live for over thirty years, so the one eyeing up your chips may have been running this pier since before you were born.
species.name: Pierlord

dex.text: Patrols the harbour wall as if it owns the freehold. Technically the gulls do, and it is not letting anyone forget it.
dex.fact: Herring gull chicks peck at a red spot on the parent's bill to ask for food.
